Un repère de pliage des cahiers, vestige du façonnage du livre : un chiffre nu, sans contexte, rattaché par proximité à la dernière valeur du tableau au-dessus.
seen.excerpt_en: Observed on 2026-08-08 by a delegated observer, on the PDFs of the migraine corpus: "a lone 4, bottom left under the last row of a table, while the page folio is 149 top right". A gathering signature from the bookbinder, a vestige of the printing: a bare digit, without context, attached by proximity to the last value of the table above.
